$comment: Personal mapping for the Personal Knowledge plugin. Drop this file at ~/.personal-knowledge/repo-map.json and the plugin picks it up automatically (no settings needed); or point PERSONAL_KNOWLEDGE_CONFIG at any path. Optional top-level keys: vaultPath (absolute path to a non-default Obsidian vault), defaultNotes, projects, topicRoutes, ignoreFolders, backupRetentionDays. The conversation archive appends 09 Conversations/_raw and 09 Conversations/_daily to ignoreFolders by itself (see ADR 0002), so a transcript is never indexed. Paths are vault-relative except repoPrefixes, which are absolute filesystem prefixes.
